articles.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.1% as energy costs soar
articles.description: The reading comes a day before the Bank of England updates its monetary policy.

articles.title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
articles.description: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

articles.title: Fed meeting is shaping up to be a nightmare for Warsh. Bitcoin might still shine
articles.description: An aggressive market expectations trap and a strict aversion to forward guidance have backed the Fed chair into a corner, where failing to deliver a hawkish message risks destroying the central bank’s inflation-fighting credibility.

articles.title: AI has been a ‘net negative’ for crypto: Phemex CEO
articles.description: Federico Variola says AI has diverted capital from crypto and is empowering attackers, while rising cybersecurity costs could push the industry toward greater centralization.

articles.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
articles.description: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

articles.title: Zcash holders overwhelmingly back faster transactions and bitcoin-style halvings
articles.description: Nearly 2.4 million ZEC participated, with 99.9% backing 25-second blocks and 98.9% voting to preserve the network’s existing halving schedule.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Bond yields are spiking, oil is up — but investors aren’t giving up on stocks
articles.description: Rising Treasury yields, geopolitical risk and fresh AI safety concerns are hitting markets, but many investors remain bullish on AI spending and earnings.

articles.title: Oil falls as U.S. crude inventories reportedly rise, traders weigh Saudi pipeline closure
articles.description: Oil fell Wednesday, as an unexpected increase in U.S. crude inventories outweighed worries over supply disruptions after an Iran-backed attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline.

articles.title: Treasury yields hitting 5% may not break markets now — but the clock is ticking
articles.description: The 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2007, pushing borrowing costs deeper into territory that could expose some of the financial system's weakest links.

articles.title: US charges ex-Robinhood engineers over alleged pre-listing crypto trades
articles.description: The former employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetuals ahead of Robinhood token listings.

articles.title: Inside South Korea’s university programs offering a direct route to Samsung and SK Hynix
articles.description: Companies are helping universities develop courses, provide financial support and create pathways through which qualifying students can join them.

articles.title: Grab aims for 'next level' in financial services with purchase of buy-now pay-later platform Atome
articles.description: Grab is betting $1.49 billion on Atome Financial as it looks to expand its consumer lending business in Southeast Asia.

articles.title: Nvidia's Huang diverges with CEOs of Anthropic, OpenAI on AI safety at Dreamforce
articles.description: Comments from the two tech leaders landed days after Anthropic's Dario Amodei published an essay urging the AI industry to slow the pace of model development.

articles.title: Crypto longs worth $570 million wiped out as Clarity Act fails
articles.description: Bullish crypto futures bets worth millions have been liquidated in 24 hours. Bitcoin and ether longs have taken in the most losses.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
articles.description: The $450 million withdrawal came as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, with Fidelity and BlackRock funds leading the outflows.

articles.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
articles.description: Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba and Tencent did not provide any statements when contacted by CNBC about the warnings on AI from Silicon Valley.

articles.title: XRP sinks 10% as the Clarity Act fails and bitcoin slides toward $76,000
articles.description: The Senate's 49-50 procedural vote left the crypto market structure bill 11 short of what it needed, and every major token fell.

articles.title: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback
articles.description: The CLARITY Act still has a procedural path after Senator Thom Tillis moved to reconsider the failed cloture vote, though industry executives are divided over whether Congress has enough time left.

articles.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg sides with Nvidia's Huang on AI safety and slowdown debate
articles.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's view of artificial intelligence safety is akin to the perspective of Nvidia's Jensen Huang rather than Anthropic chief Dario Amodei.
